Name: Ridgeside Village Quest Fix For Linux and Mac
Author: pneuma163
Description:
[size=3]If you have seen the yellow text [b]"[color=#ffff00]Failed parsing new quests.[/color]"[/b] in your SMAPI console while playing with Ridgeside Village, this mod is for you. If you've never seen Keahi request a tomato for a secret project nor seen Yuuma request an iron bar to fix the swings, this mod is for you. If you've only ever gotten fish related quests at the RSV daily quest board, this mod is for you.[/size]

[size=3]This mod fixes a bug in Ridgeside Village that only applies if your computer's operating system is Mac or Linux (including if it's a Steam Deck) or some other that respects capitalization. Windows users do not need this mod. This bug will very likely be fixed in the next update of Ridgeside Village at which point this mod will not be useful. After installing this mod, you may need to sleep one day for quests to begin appearing.[/size]

[size=6][u][b]How to install:[/b][/u][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Make sure you have Ridgeside Village installed (otherwise this mod is irrelevant).[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=3]If you need additional help installing the mod, the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Stardew Valley wiki[/url]﻿ has more detailed instructions.
To uninstall the mod, delete this mod's folder from your Mods folder.
[/size]

You can also fix this bug if you download the C# code for Ridgeside Village and fix it yourself and then compile your own RidgesideVillage.dll file, but I thought it would be nice to have a mod available since not everyone knows how to do that.

[url=https://codeberg.org/pneuma163/StardewValleyMods/src/branch/main/RSV%20Quest%20Fix]source code[/url]

Manifest.Name: RSV Quest Fix
Manifest.Description: Fix quest parsing warning for RSV to allow all daily quests on Linux and Mac
Manifest.Author: pneuma163
